question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.3.
solution:
The correct answer is 'knew'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• *He (3) ______ that he must fight for his family*
 
• If we take a look at the passage, it is in **the simple past tense**. Thus, the most appropriate option for blank 3 is **'knew'.**
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **option 3.**

Correct Passage:__ *King Priam of Troy was old and weak, but his son Hector was a (1) __valiant__ and noble young man. Hector had sensed (2) __danger__ when his brother had brought Helen to Troy. He **(3) __knew__** that he must fight for his family but (4) ______ the circumstances that had set hero against hero. The (5) ______ warriors on the Trojan side were Achilles, Aeneas and Agamemnon. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• ** Past tense:** It represents an action which started in past, finished in past and has no relation to the present.

 
 
• **Structure:**

 
 
• Subject+ The second form of verb.
 
 
• **Example:** He **went **to the market yesterday.
